name: 哈森-威廉姆斯水头损失计算器

map.由流量、管长、粗糙系数 C 与管径，按 h_f = 10.67·L·Q^1.85: Compute head loss h_f = 10.67*L*Q^1.852/(C^1.852*D^4.87) from flow, pipe length, roughness coefficient C and diameter (SI units).
map.适用于水温约 4–25℃ 的给水管道；C 值：新钢管≈120–140，旧管≈80: For water-supply pipe at ~4–25 ℃; C: new steel ≈120–140, old pipe ≈80–100.
map.单位为 SI（Q: m³/s，D: m，结果 m）。: SI units (Q: m³/s, D: m, result m).
map.给水管网按经验式估沿程损失。: Water network: estimate friction loss by the empirical formula.
map.C 从 120 降到 100（旧管），同条件损失增约 40%，结垢显著抬升能耗。: C 120→100 (old pipe) raises loss ~40% at same conditions; scaling lifts energy use sharply.
map.海曾-威廉粗糙系数，新钢管 130~140、旧管或水泥管更低，材质越光滑越大。: Hazen-Williams roughness coefficient; new steel 130–140, old or cement pipe lower, smoother material = larger.
map.海曾为给水经验式，含 C 不直接显 f；达西更通用但需 f(Re,ε)。: Hazen-Williams is a water-supply empirical formula with C, not showing f; Darcy is more general but needs f(Re,ε).
